items.title: Use OpenTelemetry as ctrl's execution acquisition fabric
items.summary: OpenTelemetry Python and contrib already provide the generic execution-observation, context propagation and provider-adapter layer that ctrl would otherwise need to build. ctrl-specific instrumentation should concentrate on CPython probes, regrtest, qualification operations and semantic join identities.
items.localContractImpact: Add an observation adapter family around OpenTelemetry context/signals; reuse contrib instrumentors for generic Python plumbing and preserve custom semantic probes for domain evidence.

observations.observation: OpenTelemetry Python main provides the API/SDK substrate and OTLP/export surfaces used as ctrl's generic causal execution-observation layer.
Contrib documents independently installable instrumentation packages, API-only dependencies for instrumented libraries, application-selected SDKs, and beta maturity.

claims.text: Generic runtime plumbing should be acquired through OpenTelemetry provider/instrumentation packages while ctrl retains domain-specific CPython and qualification probes.
OpenTelemetry observations provide causal/runtime evidence only and cannot serve as AST, symbol, compiler, analyzer or qualification authority.

items.title: Correlate agent and MCP execution with qualification traces
items.summary: GenAI semantic conventions and their Python realization provide a ready-made observation family for model/client/MCP/provider activity that can share trace context with repository, analyzer, CPython and qualification operations.
items.localContractImpact: Bind GenAI/MCP/OpenAI observations to qualification-run, repository-revision, tool, probe and evidence identities without making trace IDs semantic object identities.

observations.observation: The GenAI extension defines spans, metrics and events for GenAI clients, MCP and provider-specific conventions including OpenAI, with major documentation generated from YAML model definitions and Weaver-managed core-semconv dependencies.
Python GenAI instrumentations build on the OpenTelemetry Python SDK/contrib substrate, emit according to GenAI semantic conventions, and include released OpenAI and OpenAI Agents instrumentations.

claims.text: Agent/model/tool/MCP operations can participate in the same causal trace as analysis and qualification while remaining a distinct observation family.

items.title: Adopt OTel-Arrow as the columnar telemetry projection
items.summary: OTel-Arrow already supplies the OTLP-to-columnar bridge: OTAP is defined as a non-lossy column-oriented OpenTelemetry protocol, represented as Arrow record batches, with an embeddable Rust dataflow engine and Arrow IPC/Parquet persistence paths.
items.localContractImpact: Qualify OTLP/OTAP round-trip preservation and consume OTAP Arrow/Parquet outputs at ctrl's relational ingress before considering any bespoke SpanExporter-to-Arrow implementation.

observations.observation: OTel-Arrow documents OTAP as the column-oriented equivalent of OTLP with straightforward non-lossy round trips and represents OTAP signals using multiple Arrow record batches in a star-schema arrangement.
The Rust OTAP Dataflow Engine is documented as embeddable and includes OTLP/OTAP I/O, routing/filtering/sampling, Arrow IPC durable buffering, DataFusion transforms and Parquet export.

claims.text: ctrl should first qualify and reuse the existing OTLP -> OTAP -> Arrow path rather than create an independent telemetry-to-Arrow semantic conversion layer.

items.title: Keep external facts separate from execution observations
items.summary: dlt and OpenTelemetry solve different acquisition problems: dlt acquires external data facts while OpenTelemetry acquires execution observations. Both may converge at Arrow/relational ingress without collapsing provenance.
items.localContractImpact: Preserve acquisition-family identity in normalized facts and correlation joins.

observations.observation: dlt documents declarative API acquisition and extract/normalize/load pipelines with DuckDB as a local destination.
OpenTelemetry is bound in the ctrl profile to execution observations and causal context, not external domain-data acquisition.

claims.text: External facts and execution observations may share relational storage but must retain distinct acquisition provenance.

items.title: Treat telemetry maturity as qualification metadata, not authority
items.summary: The selected telemetry ecosystem includes beta Python instrumentation and an actively developing OTAP Dataflow Engine. These are suitable experimental adapters but are not promoted into ctrl semantic authority.
items.localContractImpact: Record component maturity/version in evidence and pin realized adapters before relying on them for reproducible qualification runs.

observations.observation: Python contrib explicitly labels its instrumentation libraries beta.
Current released GenAI Python instrumentations shown in the repository are beta releases such as 1.0b0 and 1.0b1.
OTel-Arrow states it is completing the Dataflow Engine phase and does not currently provide pre-built Dataflow Engine releases.

claims.text: Experimental telemetry adapters may produce evidence but do not become ctrl semantic or qualification authority.
